preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (return_value != palindrome and return_value != return_value[::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is either an empty string or a string that is not a palindrome and is lexicographically smaller than the input.
